description: The original Mass Mobilization codebook and official baseline/ID mapping were not included in the working materials; provisional candidate categories cannot be treated as official coding or approval.
required_followup: Coordinator should verify the authoritative codebook version, observation universe, original fields and country-code/ID mapping before consolidation or any official comparison.

description: Nine relevant source bodies were not retrieved after exact-URL access checks: web.open returned Cache miss for S003, S009–S012, S014–S017; ordinary exact-URL HTTPS attempts for S010 and S016 failed DNS before HTTP. S005 provided only a visible excerpt before a sign-in/registration prompt. These are technical/access-scope limits, not evidence of publisher denial except the visible BTA sign-in barrier.
required_followup: If accessible through the approved workflow, read contemporaneous article bodies from their exact captured URLs after a fresh receipt and manual review. Do not infer event facts from unverified snippets or try alternate URLs to bypass a barrier.

description: Jan. 12 has two reports above 3,000, but the count origin and independence are not established. The Jan. 16 attendance is only a search snippet saying several hundred; the Jan. 26 headline says low-turnout without a number. Local-event eligibility at the 50-person threshold remains unresolved.
required_followup: Check full contemporaneous reports, organizers’ count basis, independent estimates and precise numerical evidence; assign no bound to qualitative or snippet-only descriptions.

description: Physical end times are not established for any candidate. Jan. 16 and Jan. 26 occurrence/date attribution rely partly on search-only reports; the Jan. 16 opened BNR page is only an advance announcement.
required_followup: Verify execution dates and physical start/end from contemporaneous reporting or event records; do not infer closure from article dates or scheduled times.

description: The Jan. 16 and Jan. 26 Kustendil leads concern the same tax issue but do not establish whether either assembly occurred, whether organizers overlapped, or whether the later action was a separate event. The Jan. 12 account mentions a separate Nov. 11, 2022 energy-sector demonstration.
required_followup: Compare full reports across January and neighboring months; preserve Jan. 16/26 as distinct candidates unless evidence establishes the event boundary, and do not roll the November action into January.

description: For Jan. 12, parliamentary-group contact/support is reported, but causation and the relationship between the assembly and the formal resolution are unclear. For the local-tax leads, event-specific accommodation, arrests, beatings, dispersal, ignoring, killings and shootings remain unknown. Silence is not evidence of no response or no violence.
required_followup: Review full event-specific reports and public records for response to each action; preserve unknown values unless an explicit event-linked fact supports yes or no_explicit.

description: The nine grouped English/Bulgarian web-search invocations provide a bounded first pass, not exhaustive monthly coverage. LexisNexis and systematic press archives were unavailable; local/regional, independent civil-society, sector and small-town coverage remains uneven, and no absence claim is warranted.
required_followup: Coordinator/researcher should extend Bulgarian-language regional and sector-specific coverage using accessible contemporaneous archives and document archive, language and geographic limits.
